title: frangula wendtii
intro: Frangula wendtii, commonly known as the New Zealand quinine tree or the small quinine tree, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of gastrointestinal issues and as a natural laxative due to its anthraquinone content. The therapeutic actions of Frangula wendtii include stimulating bowel movements, treating constipation, and supporting liver health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, such as aloe-emodin and rhein, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
